findings.evidence: Symmetries.lean:347-359 and 368-380 contain the same ten-line argument twice; ValenceContent.lean:211-223 shows the conj case already factored and consumed by a three-line rewrite.
findings.fix: Add `ValenceInvariant.image_inter_valence` and `ValenceInvariant.image_sdiff_valence` to EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/ValenceContent.lean beside the existing `HadronMultiplet.image_conj_*` lemmas (stated for `hv : ValenceInvariant valence τ (Species.map ρ)`; note `Finset.image_inter` is unavailable without injectivity of `ρ`, so keep the `ext` proof but write it once), and reduce both `favored_map_of_flavorSymmetryRelation` and `unfavored_map_of_flavorSymmetryRelation` to the same three-line `rw [..._def, ..._def, ← hv.image_..., Finset.sum_image ...]` shape as their charge-conjugation counterparts.
findings.issue: The `have hs` block (lines 347-356) and the identical block in `unfavored_map_of_flavorSymmetryRelation` (lines 368-377) each prove, by a hand-rolled `ext`/`constructor`/`rintro` argument, that `Species.map ρ` carries `flavorPair i ∩ valence h` (resp. `\ valence h`) onto `flavorPair (ρ i) ∩ valence (τ h)`. The two differ only in `Finset.mem_inter` vs `Finset.mem_sdiff` and the two `mt`s. These are statements about `ValenceInvariant`, `Species.map` and `flavorPair` with no fragmentation content, and they are exactly the flavour-relation analogues of `HadronMultiplet.image_conj_inter_valence` / `image_conj_sdiff_valence`, which are already factored out in ValenceContent.lean and used by `favored_conj_of_chargeConjRelation` / `unfavored_conj_of_chargeConjRelation` (Symmetries.lean:326, 336).

summary: Proofs are otherwise robust: no `change`/`show`, automation (`grind`, `simp_all`, `linarith`) used where appropriate, and the `rfl`/`simpa` steps rest on this PR's own reindexing definitions rather than accidental defeq. One substantial piece of reasoning is duplicated inline instead of being factored next to the lemmas it mirrors.
